title: Default Green Blue Theme
description: The standard Minecraft textures, but with a green and blue theme.
body:
💚 Default Green Blue Theme – Clean & Modern Interface 💙

This texture pack changes the normal gray Minecraft textures into beautiful blue-green tones.

🖼️ Feel free to check out the gallery to get an impression 🖼️

🔷 Features:

-  Minimalist GUI with a blue-green color palette 
-  Easy on the eyes for long play sessions 
-  Redesigned menus, inventory, and HUD 
-  Lightweight & performance-friendly 
-  Compatible with most mods and clients

Whether you're playing PvP, Survival, or Creative — Default Green Blue Theme is a feature to make the game look nicer.
